headlines.title: COP31 hosts Australia and Türkiye face the fossil-fuel question
Roberto Mancini: 'Türkiye çok iyi bir takım, elenmeyi hak etmediler'
Turkish opposition CHP leader signals he may not run again
I spent $7,500 on a full-body checkup and cosmetic procedures in Turkey
Palauan youth and climate advocate joins COP31 engagements across Türkiye

brief.text:
SITUATION NOW
COP31 hosts Australia and Türkiye face the fossil-fuel question. [1]
Turkish opposition CHP leader signals he may not run again. [3]

WHAT THIS MEANS FOR TURKEY
Türkiye's role as a COP31 host raises pressure to address its 68% net energy import dependency, which the fossil-fuel question directly challenges. [1][E4]
The CHP leader's potential departure may affect the party's electoral prospects, as a market prices CHP winning the general election at 12%. [3][E10]

KEY RISKS
Turkey's link to 383 US OFAC and Canada SEMA sanctions designations exposes it to financial and diplomatic risks. [E3]

OUTLOOK
A Kalshi market related to Turkey, "Where will Putin and Zelenskyy next meet?: Turkey", priced Yes at 28% on Sep 28, 2026; it closes Dec 31, 2028. [E7]
A Kalshi market related to Turkey, "Where will Trump and Putin next meet?: Turkey", priced Yes at 46% on Sep 28, 2026; it closes Jan 1, 2029. [E8]

WATCH ITEMS
Whether the Turkish opposition CHP leader will run again remains unresolved. [3]
